 Match Overview
 Guimaraes host Porto on Sunday, November 8 in the 2026-27 Primeira Liga. They come into this one off a scoreless draw with Gil Vicente on November 2, a result that followed a 5-0 win over Marítimo and a narrow 1-0 victory against Recreativa. The goals dried up last time out, but the two wins before that show Guimaraes can score freely when things click. Hosting the league leaders from Porto gives them a chance to prove that run was no fluke. Add as a preferred source on Google 
 Porto arrive in good form, having beaten Napoli 4-1 on November 4. That followed a 4-0 win over Estoril and a 1-0 result against Académico, meaning they have scored heavily in two of their last three outings. The win over Napoli stands out given the quality of that opponent, and it adds to a stretch where Porto have found the net in every match. They will travel to Guimaraes looking to keep that momentum going and stay on top of the table. Guimaraes vs Porto: last 10 meetings
